name: Fusion Fermentation
description: Harley Estate introduces Fusion Fermentation Coffee, Made from selectively handpicked ripe cherries above 18% Brix. The cherries are washed, floaters removed, inoculated with selected yeast and bacteria, then anaerobically fermented to enhance flavour and cup quality.

name: Vintage 24 - Speciality Arabica
description: FLORA & FAUNA NO.1 In the first edition of our Harley Vintage Series, we showcase the endemic flora surrounding Harley Estate. Our Specialty Arabica is steeped in flowers like Hibiscus and rose. The Coffee cherries then undergo controlled fermentation in sealed tanks, enhancing their natural flavours for a complex and long-lasting floral cup. FLORAL, PEACH, JAGGERY, CINNAMON, SWEET ORANGE & HINT OF HAZELNUT Roast Profile : Light to Medium

name: Black Honey
description: Classic Coffee introduces Black Honey Coffee. name: Nitrogen Maceration
description: Harley Estate introduces Nitrogen Maceration Coffee, post harvesting whole cherries are washed with clean water & kept in a sealed maceration tank, which is flushed with nitrogen gas to initiate fermentation, after fermentation, tyhe cherries are carefully dried, This method is a 100% anaerobic process of fermentation , which enhances fruit clarity, Sweetness &refined berry notes in the bean

name: THE ROBUSTA SERIES

Whole cherries are washed with clean water and then stored in an airtight container for fermentation along with yeast developed in-house, which increases the tartness in the final cup. The Monarch We start with selectively picking ripe red cherries with a high Brix %. The best fruits are pulped and slow fermented with a freeze dried in-house yeast & lactic acid bacteria, by varying the fermentation time and the % lactic acid to yeast, we were able to replace the citrus & fruit notes, with sweet hazel nut cream dark cherry & brandy jam. Plume Prince We start with selectively picking ripe red cherries with a high Brix %. Post manual & mechanical sorting and garbling to remove twigs, leaves, floats and other extraneous matters the best fruits are separated. The best fruits are pulped and slow fermented with a freeze dried in-house yeast & lactic acid bacteria. The yeast used & the slow drying bring out a lot of fruitiness in the coffee Thunder Hoof We start with selectively picking ripe red cherries with a high Brix %. Sugar Glider We start with selectively picking ripe red cherries with a high brix %. Post manual & mechanical sorting and garbling to remove twigs, leaves, floats and other extraneous matters the best fruits are separated. name: Sacred Ficus
description: This specialty coffee is crafted from pulped coffee cherries, fermented for 24 hours with fig-based starter culture. The beans are then gently washed and carefully dried to preserve clarity and balance. The cup reveals refined sweetness, subtle fruit complexity, and a clean, aromatic finish.

name: Citrus Reverie
description: Our newest specialty coffee is crafted from pulped Arabica beans, fermented for 24 hours in a citronella-based enzymatic solution. The beans are then carefully hand-washed to remove the mucilage and slowly dried to preserve clarity and character. The result is vibrant cup with layered complexity, delicate citrus nuances, and a refined aromatic finish.

name: Golden Jack
description: Our newest specialty coffee is crafted from Arabica cherries fermented for 36 hours with a jackfruit-based starter culture. The cherries are then carefully dried on raised beds,allowing for slow,even moisture reduction and enhanced clarity. The result is a vibrant cup with layered sweetness, expressive fruit character, and a refined aromatic finish.

name: Harmonia
description: Our newest  speciality coffee is crafted from pulped Arabica beans, fermented for 36 hours with a culture of wild yeasts derived from native flora and fauna. The beans are then gently washed to remove residual mucilage and slowly dried to preserve clarity and expression. The cup reveals vibrant structure, layered complexity, and refined aromatics with a distinctive, terroir-driven finish.

name: Golden Orchard
description: This specialty coffee is produced from whole coffee cherries fermented for 32 hours with a Barbodosa cherry extract and whey. The cherries are then carefully dried to stabilize the profile and preserve clarity. The cup presents layered complexity, enchaced sweetness, and refined aromatics with a distinctive fermentation character.

name: Classic Wet Plum
description: Classic Coffee introduces our new single-origin microlot from Harley Estate - Wet Plum Coffee Whole ripe cherries are washed with clean water and then stored in an airtight container, for fermentation, along with the introduction of a plum bacteria developed in-house. Post which a slow drying method is adapted to allow the coffee to develop maximum flavours and thereby imparting flavours of a ripe juicy plum. Roast Profile : Light to Medium

name: Yeast Maceration
description: Classic coffee introduces Yeast Maceration Coffee. Whole cherries are washed with clean water and then stored in an airtight container for fermentation along with yeast developed in-house, which increases the tartness in the final cup.

name: Natural Maceration
description: Classic Coffee introduces Natural Maceration Coffee. Post harvesting, whole ripe cherries are washed with clean water and then kept in an airtight container for fermentation. by managing the pH levels during maceration, we break down the sugar content, and increase the sweetness.

name: Banana Washed
description: Classic Coffee introduces Burundi Washed Coffee. This controlled fermentation and drying process has given this coffee a burst of floral & sweet citrus notes

name: Sugarcane Maceration
description: Classic Coffee introduces Sugarcane Maceration Coffee.
